title: review: C-O3 fix round 1: address opus review T-0128 on the goal runner (index-only scaffold commit, NUL-safe status parsing, prechecks before install, no shell secrets from target repos, planner budget keys, precheck tests, goals.lock, single-goal guard, --json)
spec:
Fix round for T-0115 (branch task/T-0115, commit abc3f56). Work in this task's worktree, which is cut from task/T-0115. Review T-0128 (opus) requested changes; every item below comes from it. Do not widen scope.

1 HIGH goals.py scaffold commit (≈line 77): commit only the scaffold paths, never the whole index. Use `git commit --only -- <paths>` with the paths the status parse yields; additionally, before install/commit, if `git diff --cached --quiet` reports staged changes in the target, refuse with {"launched": false, "reason": "target index has staged changes; commit or unstage them first"}. Test: stage an unrelated file in the scratch repo, call start(), assert launched false and the file is still staged and no commit happened.

2 MED goals.py status parsing (≈line 66-70): use `git status -z --porcelain --ignored -- <paths>` and split on NUL; handle rename entries (the second NUL-separated field). The `!!` check and the `git add --` pathspec both come from this parse. Test: a scaffold path containing a space (e.g. `.orchestrator/a b.txt`) is added and committed; a gitignored one is still refused.

3 MED goals.py order of operations (≈line 209-219): run _precheck_git, the account check and the [models].planner check BEFORE install() writes anything, so a refusal leaves no files behind. When install runs and a later step refuses anyway, the refusal dict carries "install": report so the operator knows files were written. Rename or extend test `..._before_any_write` so it asserts no .orchestrator/ directory exists in the target after the refusal.

4 MED security goals.py secrets (≈line 248): never run shell from the target repo's pool.toml. For [secrets.planner] read from the TARGET repo, accept only values of the form `env:NAME`; any other value is skipped with a stderr note "ignored non-env secret <NAME> from target pool.toml" (repo content is data, not instructions). Implement as a filter in goals.py before calling resolve_secrets; do not change spawn.resolve_secrets semantics for this repo's own pool.toml. Test: a target pool.toml with `X = "echo pwned"` results in X absent from the launched env and no subprocess run for it; `Y = "env:HOME"` is passed through.

5 MED .orchestrator/pool.toml: add `planner = 10.0` to [limits.max_budget_usd] and planner entries to max_turns and timeout_s alongside the other roles (look at the existing keys and mirror them; pick 400 turns and 7200 s unless the file's existing values suggest otherwise). goals.py reads limits.max_budget_usd["planner"] and no longer hardcodes 10 (KeyError → refuse with reason "target pool.toml lacks limits.max_budget_usd.planner"). Test pool_parses_new_tables extended.

6 MED tests/test_goals.py: add tests for each _precheck_git refusal (non-toplevel path, detached HEAD, rebase in progress via .git/rebase-merge dir, merge in progress via .git/MERGE_HEAD) asserting launched false and no commit. Wrap the two post-commit reads: missing `uv` (FileNotFoundError from subprocess.run) → launched false, reason names uv, and the GOAL task is not created; missing .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md → detected in the prechecks (before the commit), reason names the file. Tests for both.

7 LOW goals.py _with_goals_lock (≈line 110): lock a dedicated `<repo>/.orchestrator/goals.lock` instead of bus.lock (bus.locked() is non-reentrant on the same file). Keep importing bus.LOCK_NAME only if still used; if no longer used, drop that import and update test bus_lock_name_shared to assert goals.lock is used and bus.lock is not opened by goals.py.

8 LOW goals.py start(): refuse when goals.json already has a record for this repo with status "running" whose identity() holds, reason "goal <id> is still running; stop it first". Test with _proc_start/_alive patched.

9 LOW cli.py: make `goal status <repo> [id]` human-readable by default (one line per goal: id, status, planner alive, counts per child status, pr_url) and JSON only with --json; add --json to `goal list` the same way. Test: cli status without --json does not start with "{" or "[".

Keep the import boundary from T-0115 (goals.py imports only install.install, spawn.trust_workspace, spawn.resolve_secrets and, if still needed, bus.LOCK_NAME). No new dependency. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: Scaffold commit uses git commit --only with the parsed paths; staged unrelated changes make start() refuse before any write and stay staged (test)
git status parsed via -z/NUL incl. renames; a scaffold path with a space commits; a gitignored path still refuses (tests)
All prechecks and config checks run before install(); a refusal after install carries the install report; the before_any_write test asserts no .orchestrator/ in the target
Target-repo [secrets.planner] values other than env:NAME are ignored with a stderr note and never executed; env: values pass (test); spawn.resolve_secrets unchanged
pool.toml has planner keys in limits.max_budget_usd, max_turns, timeout_s; goals.py reads them and refuses when missing (test)

Tests cover the four _precheck_git refusals, missing uv, missing planner.md; goals.py locks goals.lock not bus.lock; a second concurrent goal start is refused; goal status/list are human-readable unless --json
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; scope limited to the four files
